SYMPTOM: Playwright launched inside Next.js API route handler hung indefinitely — 11 zombie Chromium processes, never returned.
CAUSE: Next.js server-side execution context blocks Playwright's async browser control.
FIX: Extracted to `playwright-service/server.ts` — Express server on port 3002, `POST /upload` accepts image buffer, returns `{ uuid }`. Docker service `playwright` uses Microsoft's Playwright image (`mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.x`). App calls it via HTTP: `http://playwright:3002/upload`.
PREVENT: Always run Playwright (or any subprocess-heavy browser automation) as a separate process/service, never inline in the request handler.
